items.title: HAI/RegLab estimate of AI-assisted drafting in state court filings
items.summary_en: A Stanford HAI piece reports researchers (HAI and RegLab) estimating how much AI is used in drafting county court complaints. Per the search snippet, AI-use prevalence in Santa Clara and San Francisco counties reached about 38% and 36% in 2026 (excluding debt-collection cases). Self-represented complaints in Santa Clara showing signs of AI use reportedly rose from 19% in 2024 to 72% in 2026.
items.notes: Page not fetched (hai.stanford.edu unreachable from this session); figures and date come from a search-result snippet and are unverified against the page. Headline suggests the estimates are uncertain. Linked paper/preprint status not checked.
